शंव: शंव शंव, i. e. शम् + व,  I. adj. Prosperous, happy, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 18.  II. m.  1. Indra's thunderbolt.  2. The iron head of a pestle.
शंस्: शंस् शंस्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 1, 7687),  1. To praise, MBh. 2, 2298; pass. शस्य, Chr. 292, 4 = Rigv. i. 86, 4.  2. To re-port, Man. 7, 116; Rām. 3, 55, 16.  3. Praised, Pañc. i. d. 195.  2. Said.  3. Wished.  4. Calumniated.  5. Certain. Man. 1, 104, read संशित।  Comp. अ-शस्त, adj. 1. not praiseworthy, Rājat. 5, 13. 2. inauspicious, Lass. 16, 17. शक्: शक् शक्, ii. 9, शक्नु, Par., and i. 4, शक्य, Par. Ātm.  1. To endure, MBh. 3, 11277.  2. शंकर: शंकर शंकर, i. e. शम्-कृ + अ,  I. adj.  1. Causing happiness, Padmap. 2, 6.  2. Auspicious.  II. m.  1. Śiva, Hariv. 15408; Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 20.  2. A proper name, Lass. 2. ed. 87, 16.

† 3. शठ् शठ्, श्वठ् श्वठ्, i. 10, शथय, श्वठय, Par.  1. To speak ill.  2. To speak well.  3. To be true.
† 4. शठ् शठ्, श्वठ् श्वठ्, श्वण्ठ् श्वण्ठ्, सठ् सठ्, स्वठ् स्वठ्, i. 10, Par.  1. To finish, to adorn.  2. To leave unfinished or un-adorned.
शठ: शठ शठ, probably akin to शत्रु, cf. शतेर, perhaps a form of *शत्र,  I. adj. Wicked, dishonest, perfidious, Lass. 31, 17; Hit. ii. d. 115.  II. m.  1. A rogue, a knave, Man. 7, 123.  2. A false husband or lover, Lass. 45, 5; Śṛṅgārat. 10; Mālav. d. 55 (read शठ).  3. An idler.  4. A blockhead.  5. A mediator.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. honest, Man. 3, 246. दन्त-, m. common lime, Ferronia elephantum Corr., and Aver-rhoa carambola Lin., Suśr. 1, 157, 5.
शण्: † शण् शण्, i. 1, Par.  1. To give (cf. श्रण्).  2. To move(?).
शण: शण शण, n.  1. Hemp, MBh. 3, 16350.  2. Bengal San, a plant from which a kind of hemp is prepared, Crotalaria juncea.  3. (for *शर्ण, i. e. शॄ + न), An arrow. -- Cf. κάνναϐις; O.H.G. hanaf. A.S. haenep (bor-rowed).
शणसूत्रमय: शणसूत्रमय शण-सूत्र + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting of शण-threads, Man. 2, 44.
शण्ठ: शण्ठ शण्ठ, m. An eunuch (cf. शण्ड).
शण्ड्: † शण्ड् शण्ड्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To disease.  2. To collect.
शण्ड: शण्ड शण्ड,  I. m. n. A collection of lotus flowers.  II. m.  1. An eunuch.  2. An impotent man.  3. A bull at liberty (cf. शण्ठ and शण्ढ).
शण्ढ: शण्ढ शण्ढ, m.  1. An eunuch.  2. An attendant on the women's apart-ments.  3. A bull at liberty (cf. the last, षण्ड, and षण्ढ).
शत: शत शत, numeral, n. (also m., Nal. 15, 6, शतं शतास्, ten thousand), A hundred, Chr. 28, 20 (pl.); nom. in the sense of an instr. (i. e. indecl.), Chr. 287, 7 = Rigv. i. 48, 7.  -- Comp. अध्य्-अर्ध-, i. e. अधि-अर्ध-,  I. n. a hun-dred and fifty.  II. adj. consisting of a hundred and fifty, MBh. 1, 102. अर्ध-, n. a hundred and fifty, Man. 8, 331. अष्टशत, i. e. अष्टन्-, n. eight hundred, Yājñ. 1, 302. एक-, n. a hundred and one; with गवाम्, a hun-dred cows and one bull, Man. 11, 129 (cf. 127). तावच्छत, i. e. तावन्त्-, adj., f. ती, containing so many hundreds, Man. 1, 69. त्रि-,  I. n. three hundred, Rām. 1, 13, 31 Gorr.  II. adj. three hundredth, MBh. 3, 12. दशशत, i. e. दशन्-, n., and f. ती, a thousand, MBh. 3, 2658 (त); Rājat. 5, 71 (ती). दश-रश्मि-, i. e. दशन्-, adj. (having a thousand rays), epithet of the sun, Ragh. 8, 29. द्वि-,  I. n. 1. two hun-dred. 2. hundred and two.  II. adj. 1. amounting to two hundred, Man. 8, 257. 2. two hundredth, MBh. i. adhy. 200, sqq. पञ्चशत, i. e. पञ्चन्-,  I. n., and f. ती, five hundred, Man. 8, 384 (त); Kathās. 44, 77 (ती).  II. adj. 1. five hundred, MBh. 3, 15723. 2. amounting to five hundred, Yājñ. 2, 301. 3. paying an amercement of five hundred, Man. 8, 376. परःशत, i. e. परस्-, adj., f. ता, more than a hundred, MBh. 6, 4267. -- Cf. Lat. centum; ἑ-κατόν (ἑν-κατόν); Goth. and A.S. hund.
शतक: शतक शत + क,  I. adj. Hundred.  II. (m.?), n. A century, a collection of a hundred stanzas, Bhartṛ. title.
शतखण्डमय: शतखण्डमय शत-खण्ड + मय, adj. Consisting of a hundred pieces, Bhartṛ. 3, 16 (cf. खण्ड).
शतघ्नी: शतघ्नी शतघ्नी, i. e. शत-हन् + ई, f.  1. A kind of weapon, Arj. 6, 16.  2. A female scorpion.  3. A disease of the throat.
शततम: शततम शत + तम, ord. num., f. मी, Hundredth, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 15.  -- Comp. द्वि-, adj. two hundredth, Hariv. adhy. 200. त्रि-, adj. 1. three hun-dredth, Hariv. adhy. 300. 2. hundred and third, Rām. ii. adhy. 103. च-तुःशततम, i. e. चतुर्-, adj. hundred and fourth, Rām. ii. adhy. 104. पञ्-चशततम, i. e. पञ्चन्-, adj. hun-dred and fifth, Rām. ii. adhy. 105. नवशततम, i. e. नवन्-, adj. hundred and ninth, Rām. vi. adhy. 109. द्वाविं-शति-, i. e. द्वि-विंशति-, adj. hundred and twenty-second, Rām. ii. adhy. 122 Gorr.
शतद्रु: शतद्रु शत-द्रु, f. The name of a river, the Setlej, MBh. 1, 6753.
शतधा: शतधा शत + धा, adv.  1. In a hun-dred ways, hundred-fold, Man. 12, 115.  2. In a hundred pieces, Pañc. 94, 16.
शतभिषज्: शतभिषज् शत-भिषज्, and शत-भिषा शतभिषा (a mutilation of भि-षज्), f. A lunar mansion.
शतमान: शतमान शत-मान, m. and n.  1. A पल of silver, Man. 8, 137 (m.).  2. A measure so termed.
शतयोजनवत्: शतयोजनवत् शत-योजन + वत्, adv. As if a hundred योजनस् large, Panc. i. d. 147.
शतशस्: शतशस् शत + शस्, adv. By hun-dreds, a hundred-fold, Chr. 30, 8; 36, 22.
शतशाखत्व: शतशाखत्व शत-शाख + त्व (cf. शाखा), n. Condition of having many branches, of being much increased, Rājat. 5, 376.
शतसंघशस्: शतसंघशस् शत-संघ + शस्, adv. By hundreds, Arj. 10, 23.
शतिन्: शतिन् शतिन्, i. e. शत + इन्,  I. adj. Consisting of hundreds, Chr. 291, 15 = Rigv. i. 64, 15.  II. m. One who is possessed of a hundred, Pañc. v. d. 69.
शतेर: शतेर शतेर (cf. शत्रु), m.  1. An enemy.  2. Injury.
शत्रु: शत्रु शत्रु (rather शत्त्रु शत्त्रु, i. e. probably शद् or शत्, for शातय, Caus. of शद्, + त्रु, cf. Goth. hats; A.S. hate, héte; perhaps Lat. hod in odisse, hestis, and below), m. An enemy, a foe, Pañc. i. d. 131.  -- Comp. इन्द्र-, m. Prahlāda, Ragh. 7, 32. क्रौञ्च-, m. the god of war, Mṛcch. 173, 15. देव-, m. 1. an Asura, MBh. 7, 6296. 2. a Rāk-ṣasa, Rām. 6, 36, 83. बहु-, adj. having many enemies, Kathās. 4, 106. विबुध-, m. a demon, Vikr. d. 3. वृत्र-, m. Indra. -- Cf. ἔχθος, ἐχθρός, ὀχθέω.
शत्रुंसह: शत्रुंसह शत्रुंसह, i. e. शत्रु + म् -सह् + अ, adj. Bearing, or patient with an enemy.
शत्रुघ्न: शत्रुघ्न शत्रु-घ्न,  I. adj. Killing a foe.  II. m. a proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 31, 9.
शत्रुञ्जय: शत्रुंजय शत्रुंजय, i. e. शत्रु + म् -जि + अ,  I. adj. Subduing an enemy.  II. m.  1. A proper name, Draup. 2, 11.  2. An elephant.  3. The name of a mountain.
शत्रुंजय: शत्रुंजय शत्रुंजय, i. e. शत्रु + म् -जि + अ,  I. adj. Subduing an enemy.  II. m.  1. A proper name, Draup. 2, 11.  2. An elephant.  3. The name of a mountain.
शत्रुतस्: शत्रुतस् शत्रु + तस्, adv. From any enemy, Nal. 14, 18.
शत्रुता: शत्रुता शत्रु + ता, f., and शत्रुत्व शत्रु + त्व, n. Enmity, hostility, Pañc. ii. d. 32; Cāṇ. 19 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 408.
शत्वरी: शत्वरी शत्वरी, i. e. शम् + त्वन् + ई (cf. शमनी, s. v. शमन, र् for न्), f. The night.
शद्: शद् शद् substitutes in the pres., imperf., imperat., and potent. the pass. of शी, viz. शीय; in the remaining forms, Par. To fall, Bhaṭṭ. 17, 77 (शीय). Caus.  I. शातय (probably a denomin., perhaps from an anomal. ptcple. of the pf. pass. शात for शत्त, cf. the substi-tution of a vowel long by nature for one long by position, and vice versā in the Prākṛ. languages), To fell, to throw down, Rām. 1, 66, 10. शातित, Cut off, Rām. 1, 66, 12, Seramp.  II. शादय, To drive, Pāṇ. vii. 3, 42. -- With the prep. प्र प्र, Caus. शातय, To break off, MBh. 1, 5561. -- With वि वि, Caus. शा-तय, To break to pieces, MBh. 3, 11971.  -- With सम् सम्, Caus. शातय, The same, MBh. 3, 865. -- Cf. Lat. cadere.
शद: शद शद् + अ, also (but wrongly) सद सद, m. Any edible vegetable pro-duct, as fruits, Man. 8, 151; 241 (with स्).
शद्रि: शद्रि शद् + रि,  I. m.  1. A cloud.  2. An elephant.  3. Arjuna.  II. f. lightning.
शनकैस्: शनकैस् शनकैस्, i. e. शन + क, instr. pl. (cf. शनैस्), adv.  1. By degrees, gradually, Man. 7, 172.  2. In every case that arises, Man. 7, 116.  3. Mildly, Śiś. 9, 26; Chr. 41, 5.
शनि: शनि शनि (cf. शनैस्), and शनैश्चर शनैश्चर, i. e. शनैस्-चर, m. The planet Saturn, Pañc. 50, 19 (शनैश्-चर); Rām. 2, 52, 15 (शनैश्चर).
शनैस्: शनैस् शनैस् (probably for शम्नैस्, instr. pl. of an old ptcple. pf. pass. of शम्), adv. (properly ‘With intervals of quiet’).  1. Hesitating, slowly, Vikr. 71, 18; stealthily, Vikr. d. 56.  2. Mildly, Chr. 32, 27.  3. Successively, by little and little, Rājat. 5, 470; at will, independently.  4. Doubled, शनैः-शनैस्, adv. By little and little, Man. 3, 233; successively, Pañc. 212, 1; step by step, 35, 8.
शंताति: शंताति शंताति, i. e. शम् + ताटि, f. Happiness, yielding bliss, Chr. 297, 20 = Rigv. i. 112, 20.
शप्: शप् शप्, i. 1 and 4, Par. Ātm. (the original signification was probably ‘To cry aloud’),  1. To execrate, to curse. Man. 3. 58.  2. With the dat., To revile, Bhaṭṭ. 8, 33.  3. To swear, Man. 8, 110.  4. To assure by an oath, Rām. 2, 11, 8. Caus.  1. To cause to swear, Man. 8, 113 (with the instr. of the ob-ject by which one is sworn).  2. To con-jure; शपितासि जीवितेन, You are conjured by the life of, Mālat. 129, 10. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To execrate, Rām. 2, 41, 3. -- With परि परि, The same, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 33. -- Cf. probably κόμπος; cf. the frequent. शंशप्।
शप: शप शप् + अ, m.  1. An impreca-tion.  2. An oath.
शपथ: शपथ शप् + अथ, m.  1. An impre-cation, curse, Pañc. 62, 2; cursing.  2. An oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal, Man. 8, 109; 190; Pañc. i. d. 130.  3. Conjuration, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 8.
शपन: शपन शप् + अन, n.  1. A curse.  2. An oath.
शफ: शफ शफ, m. and n.  1. A hoof in general, Man. 10, 89.  2. A horse's hoof.  3. The root of a tree.  -- Comp. एक-, adj. and sbst. any animal whose hoof is not cloven, Man. 10, 89. द्वि-, adj. and sbst. any cloven-footed animal, Man. 11, 168. मुख-, adj. foul-mouthed, scurrilous. -- Cf. O.H.G. huof; A.S. hóf, The hoof of a horse.
शफर: शफर शफ + र, and सफर स-फर, m., and f. री, A small fish, Cyprinus Sophore, Pañc. ii. d. 87 (र); Bhartṛ. 3, 94 (री).
शब्द्: शब्द् शब्द्, i. 10 (rather a de-nomin. derived from शब्द), शब्दय and शब्दापय, Par.  1. To sound, Śiś. 11, 47; to bray, Pañc. 224, 9.  2. To call, MBh. 3, 14400.  3. To address, Rām. 2, 59, 7 (शब्दापय). Ptcple. pf. pass. शब्दित, n. Braying (of an ass), Pañc. 249, 6. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, To declare, Man. 6, 82.  -- With सम् सम्, To say, MBh. 1, 3215.
शब्द: शब्द शब्द, i. e. शप्-द (vb. दा), m.  1. Sound, Pañc. 129, 15; noise, Pañc. 123, 24.  2. A word, Vikr. d. 1.  3. Grammar, Pañc. 4, 17; Daśak. in Chr. 180, 8.  -- Comp. जय-, m. 1. a shout of victory. 2. the exclamation जय, victory, Vikr. d. 35. ताल-, m. 1. noise produced by falling cocoa-nuts, Hariv. 3715. 2. noise produced by clapping the hands, applause, ib. 4111. निःशब्द, i. e. निस्-, adj.  I. adj. soundless, noiseless, Megh. 112 (with-out speaking); Rām. 5, 3, 47.  II. n. silence, Rām. 4, 59, 3. स-शब्द, adj. proclaimed, Rājat. 5, 361. °दम्, adv. with loud noise, Bhartṛ. 2, 86. साधु-, m. a cry of ‘Good.’
शब्दज: शब्दज शब्द-ज, adj. Produced by words, by verbal communication, Bhāṣāp. 51.
शब्दन: शब्दन शब्द् + अन,  I. adj. Sounding, sonorous.  II. n. Uttering sounds.
शब्दाय: शब्दाय शब्दाय, a denomin. derived from शब्द with य, Ātm. To sound, to cry, Pañc. 254, 21; to bray, Pañc. 249, 5.
शम्: 1. शम् शम्, i. 4, शाम्य, Par. (the original signification is ‘To get tired’),  1. To cease, Man, 2, 94.  2. To grow calm, to be appeased, MBh. 2, 1936; to grow satisfied and pacified, Rājat. 5, 400.  3. To be calm, un-disturbed, MBh. 1, 6362.  4. To sacri-fice, Chr. 292, 12 = Rigv. i. 85, 12; Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 86, 8. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शान्त।  1. Hushed, stilled (as wind).  2. Ceased, Hit. 80, 21; extinguished, Kir. 17, 16.  3. Al-layed, alleviated.  4. Calm, undis-turbed, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 7; tranquil, pacified, free from passions, Pañc. i. d. 181; content, Hit. i. d. 142, M.M.  5. Meek, humble, Chr. 48, 10.  6. Purified, cleansed.  7. Repelled, MBh. 1, 212.  8. °तम्, adv.  a. Enough, Utt. Rāmac. 71, 2.  b. A prohibitive word, implying ne-gation, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 1 (it must not befall), aversion, disgust, fie, for shame, heaven forbid, Śāk. 67, 13; Daśak. in Chr. 200, 13; hush, Utt. Rāmac. 10, 1.  9. Killed, MBh. 1, 7523. m. An ascetic. n. Appeasing, pacifying. f. ता, A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 103, 3; 173, 9. Caus., and i. 10,  I. शमय।  1. To cause to cease, to extinguish, Megh. 54; Hit. i. d. 87, M.M.  2. To tame, Vikr. d. 156; to appease, Vedān-tas. in Chr. 218, 6.  3. To remove. MBh. 5, 238; to avert, Śāk. 7, 16.  4. To subdue, MBh. 3, 14620.  5. To desist, Johns. Sel. 48, 84.  II. शामय, Ātm. To look at or inspect. -- With the prep. उप उप,  1. To cease, MBh. 4, 1775.  2. To grow quiet, MBh. 3, 1008. Caus. शामय,  1. To allay, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 16; 17.  2. To kill, MBh. 3, 8541. -- With अभ्युप अभि-उप, अभ्युपशान्त, Appeased, Ṛt. 1, 1. --With नि नि,  1. To see, MBh. 2, 1740.  2. To hear, Rām. 2, 44, 25. निशान्त, Quiet, patient. n. To hear, 2, 57, 21. -- With अभिनि अभि-नि, Caus. शामय, To perceive, Daśak. 201, 14.  -- With विनि वि-नि, To hear, MBh. 3, 1878. -- With संनि सम्-नि, To hear, MBh. 2, 1658. Caus. शामय, To summon, Chr. 52, 10. -- With परि परि, Caus. शमय, To allay, Gīt. 7, 20. -- With प्र प्र,  1. To cease, Rām. 2, 40, 33; to fade, Man. 4, 186.  2. To be restrained, Pañc. i. d. 357; to become extinguished, Pañc. iii. d. 54.  3. To be appeased, soothed, Chr. 22, 14; Pañc. i. d. 315.  4. To grow calm, MBh. 2, 1941.  5. To heal, Pañc. 253, 23. प्रशान्त,  1. Ceased, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 16 (withdrawn).  2. Dead, Rājat. 5, 21.  3. Calmed, tranquillised, Nal. 26, 35; Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 21.  4. Tamed, Lass. 53, 15.  5. Relieved. Caus.  I. शमय।  1. To allay, MBh. 2, 12978; to soothe, Man. 8, 391.  2. To extinguish, MBh. 1, 8156.  3. To kill, MBh. 2, 2031. 2. शम् शम्,  I. (sbst.), Work, Chr., 293, 5 = Rigv. i. 87, 5.  II. indecl.  1. Happy, happily, auspiciously.  2. Hail, happiness, Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 34; 8, 3, 23; Nalod. 3, 46.

शमथ: शमथ शम् + अथ, m.  1. Quiet, tranquillity of mind, absence of pas-sion.  2. A counsellor.

शमल: शमल शमल, n. Impurity, Bhāg. P. 2, 8, 5; calamity, 1, 13, 31.

शमिन्: शमिन् शमिन्, i. e. शम + इन्, adj. Tranquil, tranquillised, Utt. Rāmac. 16, 6.
शम्ब्: शम्ब् शम्ब्, see शर्ब् and सम्ब्।
शम्बर: शम्बर शम्बर, and सम्बर सम्-बर,  I. m.  1. The name of a demon, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.  2. A mountain.  3. A sort of deer.  4. A fish.  5. War.  II. n.  1. Water.  2. A religious observance.
शम्बल: शम्बल शम्बल,  I. (m. and) n.  1. Stock for travelling expenses.  2. A bank, a shore.  3. Envy.  II. f. ली, A procuress (cf. सम्बल).
शम्बु: शम्बु शम्बु (cf. the next), m. A bivalve shell.
शम्बूक: शम्बूक शम्बूक (borrowed from σαμϐύκν),  I. m. (and f. का), A bivalve shell.  II. m.  1. A conch-shell.  2. A snail.  3. The edge of the frontal protuberance of an elephant.  4. The name of a Daitya.  5. A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 1.
शम्भु: शम्भु शम्-भु (vb. भू), m.  1. Śiva, Pañc. i. d. 175.  2. Brahman.  3. A sage man.  4. A सिद्ध, a demi-divine being.
शम्या: शम्या शम् + या, f.  1. The pin of a yoke, Kātyāyana S. in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, ix. xxxvii.  2. A sacrificial vessel, ib.  3. A staff.
शम्व: शम्व शम्व, n. The iron end of a pestle.
शय: शय शय, i. e. शी + अ,  I. adj. Asleep, sleeping.  II. m.  1. Sleep.  2. A couch.  3. A snake, boa-constrictor.  -- Comp. गुहा-,  I. adj. 1. reposing in the heart, Bhāg. P. 3, 28, 19. 2. haunting caves, Suśr. 1, 200, 7.  II. m. 1. a tiger. 2. Viṣṇu. दिवा-, adj. sleeping by day, Ragh. 19, 34. नित्य-, adj. sleeping always, MBh. 3, 10415. -- Cf. ὀρέσ-κοιος.
शयथ: शयथ शयथ, i. e. शी + अथ,  I. adj. Sleepy.  II. m.  1. Death.  2. A snake, boa-constrictor.
शयन: शयन शयन, i. e. शी + अन, n.  1. Sleeping, reposing, Utt. Rāmac. 23, 1; sleep, Hit. pr. d. 28, M.M.  2. A bed, a couch, Vikr. d. 51 ( कुसुम-, of flowers).
शयानक: शयानक शयान + क (vb. शी), m. The boa-constrictor.
शयालु: शयालु शयालु, शय + आलु,  I. adj. Sleepy.  II. m.  1. A snake, boa-con-strictor.  2. A dog.
शयिन्: ऽशयिन् -शयिन्, i. e. शी + इन्, adj. Re-posing, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 7.
शयु: शयु शयु, i. e. शी + उ, m.  1. A snake, boa-constrictor.  2. A proper name, Chr. 297, 16 = Rigv. i. 112, 16.
शयुन: शयुन शयुन (see the last), m. The boa-constrictor.
शय्या: शय्या शय्या, i. e. शी + या, f. A bed, a couch, Pañc. 138, 11.  -- Comp. अ-धःशय्य, i. e. अधस्-,  I. adj. sleeping on the ground, Rām. 5, 66, 13.  II. f. या, sleeping on a low bed, Man. 2, 108. गर्भ-, f. the womb, MBh. 12, 6758. पृथक्-, f. sleeping apart, Hit. ii. d. 52. भू-, f. lying on the ground, Pañc. i. d. 301. महा-, f. a throne. वीर-, f. a certain posture, Lass. 2. ed. 70, 55.
शय्यापालत्व: शय्यापालत्व शय्या-पाल + त्व, n. The office of guarding the bed (of a king), Pañc. 63, 22.
शर: शर शर,  I. m.  1. A sort of reed, Saccharum sara, Man. 8, 247; a reed, Pañc. 140, 25.  2. An arrow (i. e. शॄ + अ), Pañc. 224, 11.  3. The cream of slightly curdled milk, Mālav. d. 43 (cream, cf. सर).  II. n. Water.  -- Comp. अ-युग्म- (having an odd number of arrows), m. Kāmadeva, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 22. कुसुम- (having flowers in-stead of arrows), m. epithet of Kāma, Ka-thās. 26, 277. पञ्चशर, i. e. पञ्चन्-(having five arrows), m. Kāma, Prab. 72, 11. पुष्प-, m. Kāma. स-, adj. furnished with arrows. हरि-, m. Śiva.
शरण: शरण शरण, n.  I. (akin to श्रि),  1. A house, Pañc. i. d. 69; habitation, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 26.  2. Refuge, Hit. i. d. 189, M.M.; protection, Pañc. 90, 5; 141, 11; 175, 12; help, Vikr. 19, 17; a protector.  II. (vb. श्री + अन), Killing.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. without a refuge, helpless, Utt. Rāmac. 74, 10; Hit. 90, 1, M.M. अशरणी-कृत, made helpless, Pañc. i. d. 241. अग्नि-, n. the sanctuary where the sacred fire is kept, Vikr. 35, 2.
शरणि: शरणि शरणि (akin to श्रि), f.  1. A row, a line.  2. A road, a path.
शरण्य: शरण्य शरण्य, i. e. शरण + य,  I. adj.  1. Needing protection, Lass. 2. ed. 90, 50; helpless, poor, miserable.  2. Yielding protection, helping, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 3; Sāv. 1, 2; Chr. 17, 25.  II. n.  1. A house.  2. Refuge, protec-tion, a protector.  3. (i. e. शॄ + अन + य), Injury, hurt.
शरद्: शरद् शरद्, and शरदा शरदा (probably from शॄ), f.  1. The autumn, Pañc. v. d. 42 (रद्).  2. A year, Utt. Rāmac. 11, 8 (रद्).  -- Comp. परिणत-शरद्, i. e. परि-नत- (vb. नम्), f. the latter part of autumn, Megh. 109.
शरदिज: शरदिज शरद् + इ-ज, adj. Produced in autumn, Utt. Rāmac. 3, 18.
शरद्वत्: शरद्वन्त् शरद् + वन्त्, m. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 59, 176.
शरद्वन्त्: शरद्वन्त् शरद् + वन्त्, m. A proper name, Johns. Sel. 59, 176.
शरधि: शरधि शरधि, i. e. शर-धा (cf. निधि), m. A quiver, Vikr. d. 18.
शरन्मेघवत्: शरन्मेघवत् शरन्मेघवत्, i. e. श-रद्-मेघ + वत्, adv. Like clouds of autumn, Hit. d. 91.
शरभ: शरभ शरभ (cf. करभ), m.  1. A fabulous animal with eight legs, stronger than a lion, Megh. 55.  2. A young elephant.  3. A camel.  4. A grasshopper (cf. शलभ).  5. A locust, Ṛt. 1, 23. -- Cf. perhaps κάραϐος; A.S. crabba.
शरमय: शरमय शर + मय, adj., f. यी, Made or consisting of शर grass.
शरयु: शरयु and यू शर + यू̆ (better स-रयू̆, q. cf.), f. The name of a river.
शरल: शरल शरल (cf. सरल),  I. adj.  1. Upright, Pañc. iii. d. 69.  2. Fraudu-lent(?).  II. m. A sort of pine, Rām. 5, 17, 15.
शरवणोद्भव: शरवणोद्भव शरवणोद्भव, and शरवणभव शरवणभव, i. e. शर -वन-उद्-भू + अ, or -वन-भव, m. A name of the god of war, Megh. 46 (°वणभ्°).
शरवाणि: शरवाणि शरवाणि, m.  1. The head of an arrow.  2. The maker of arrows.  3. A foot-soldier (probably an anomal. derivation from शर + वन्).
शरव्य: शरव्य शर + व्य (or शरु + य?), n. A butt, a mark for arrows, Śāk. d. 156; aim, Ragh. 11, 27.
शराटि: शराटि शराटि, शराडि शराडि, शराति शराति, शरारि शरारि, and शरालि शरालि, f. A bird, Turdus gin-ginianus.
शराय: शराय शराय, a denomin. de-rived from शर with य, Ātm. To be-come an arrow, Śṛṅgārat. 13.
शरारि: शरारि शरारि, शरालि शरालि, see शराटि।
शरारु: शरारु शरारु (vb. शॄ), adj. Hurt-ful, mischievous.
शराव: शराव शराव, m. and n. (ŚKD.),  1. A lid, a cover.  2. A shallow cup or dish, Hit. 114, 22; Pañc. 174, 14; Man. 6, 56; a tray, Vikr. 45, 13; a vessel (figurat. निष्ठीवन-, A spitting box), Bhartṛ. 1, 91.  3. A measure equal to two कुडवस्।  -- Comp. शक्तु-, m. a pot full of flour of barley, Hit. 115, 2.
शरासन: शरासन शरासन, i. e. शर-असन, n.  1. Shooting arrows.  2. A bow, Vikr. d. 70.
शरि: शरि शरि, i. e. शॄ + ई, adj. Hurtful.
शरिमन्: शरिमन् and शरीमन् शरी̆मन्, m. Bringing forth.
शरीर: शरीर शरीर (vb. शॄ), n.  1. The body, Pañc. iii. d. 96.  2. Life, Hit. iii. d. 103.  -- Comp. अ-, m. Kāma, Śiś. 9, 61. लिङ्ग-, n. the primary body, Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 21. शेष-, n. the remaining body, i. e. all the other parts of the body, Pañc. 38, 8. सू-क्ष्म-, n. atom-like body, a Vedāntic term, Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 5. -- Cf. perhaps A.S. hold, cadaver.
शरीरज: शरीरज शरीर-ज,  I. adj. Pro-duced by the body.  II. m.  1. A son.  2. Disease.  3. Kāma.
शरीरिन्: शरीरिन् शरीरिन्, i. e. शरीर + इन्,  I. adj., f. रिणी।  1. Embodied, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 12.  2. Living, Chr. 20, 20 (नहि वाणा मयोत्सृष्टाः सज्जन्ति शरी-रिणां कायेषु, For the arrows which I have shot do not stick in the bodies of living beings, i. e. all  I. hit with my arrows must die).  II. m.  1. A sen-tient being, Rājat. 5, 20; Pañc. iii. d. 90; a man, Pañc. ii. d. 107.  2. An embodied spirit, Man. 1, 53; 6, 64.  3. The soul, Bhag. 2, 18; Bhāṣāp. 26.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. incorporeal., Utt. Rāmac. 39, 19.
शरु: शरु शरु, i. e. शॄ + उ (or rather शर् + वन्, cf. κεραψν + ός), m.  1. An arrow.  2. The thunderbolt of Indra.  3. Any weapon.  4. Passion, anger.  -- Cf. Goth. hairus.
शर्करा: शर्करा शर्करा (probably from vb. शॄ, but cf. कर्कर), f.  1. A potsherd.  2. Gravel.  3. Stone, Rājat. 5, 432.  4. A part.  5. A soil abounding in stony fragments.  6. Clayed or candied sugar, Pañc. i. d. 423; 185, 21; Lass. 79, 16.  -- Comp. गुड-, f. sugar, Suśr. 2, 457, 5. निःशर्कर, i. e. निस्-, adj. free from stones, Rām. 1, 2, 6 Gorr. मणि-शङ्ख-शर्कर, adj. having shells and gravel consisting of jewels, Rām. 2, 63, 36, ed. Seramp. वृहत्-तुहिनशर्कर, i. e. वृहन्त्-तुहिन-, adj. full of great pieces of ice, Rājat. 3, 362.  -- Cf. Lat. calculus, calx; κρόκη, κροκάλη, κάχληξ, etc.
शर्करावत्: शर्करावन्त् शर्करा + वन्त्, and शर्करिल शर्करिल, i. e. शर्करा + इल, adj., f. वती, ला, Full of stony particles.
शर्करावन्त्: शर्करावन्त् शर्करा + वन्त्, and शर्करिल शर्करिल, i. e. शर्करा + इल, adj., f. वती, ला, Full of stony particles.
शर्ध: शर्ध शर्ध, i. e. शृध् + अ, m.  1. A fart.  2. A troop, Chr. 290, 1 = Rigv. 2. 64, 1.
शर्धञ्जह: शर्धंजह शर्धंजह, i. e. शर्ध + म्-जह (the latter is a mutilation of जहत्, the ptcple. pres. of हा), m. Any leguminous pulse (causing flatulence), as beans.
शर्धंजह: शर्धंजह शर्धंजह, i. e. शर्ध + म्-जह (the latter is a mutilation of जहत्, the ptcple. pres. of हा), m. Any leguminous pulse (causing flatulence), as beans.
शर्ब्: † शर्ब् शर्ब्, i. 1, Par.  I. To kill.  II. and शम्ब् शम्ब्, To go (cf. शर्व्).
शर्मन्: शर्मन् शर्मन् (vb. श्रि, cf. शरण), n.  1. Blessing, Chr. 292, 12 = Rigv. i. 85, 12 (ved. शर्म for शर्माणि).  2. Happiness, delight, Indr. 3, 9; Draup. 8, 23.  -- Comp. A. शर्मन् may be added at the end of all Brāhmaṇa names, as देव-, विष्णु-, m., MBh. 1, 2049; Hit. 11, 4, M.M.  B. अ-, n. misery, Kir. 12, 25.
शर्मवत्: शर्मवन्त् शर्मवन्त्, i. e. शर्मन् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Happy, auspicious, Man. 2, 32.
शर्मवन्त्: शर्मवन्त् शर्मवन्त्, i. e. शर्मन् + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Happy, auspicious, Man. 2, 32.
शर्मिष्ठा: शर्मिष्ठा शर्मिष्ठा, i. e. superl. of the last, f. A proper name, the wife of Yayāti, Śāk. d. 82; Mālav. 19, 11.
शर्या: शर्या शर्या, i. e. शॄ + या, f. Night.
शर्यात: शर्यात शर्यात, m. A proper name, Chr. 297, 17 = Rigv. i. 112, 17.
शर्व्: † शर्व् शर्व्, सर्व् सर्व्, i. 1, Par. To kill (cf. शॄ and the next).
शर्व: शर्व शर्व, i. e. शॄ + व (cf. शरु),  I. m. A name of Śiva, Pañc. ii. d. 169; Hariv. 15408.  II. f. शर्वाणी, Śiva's wife.
शर्वट: शर्वट शर्वट, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 413.
शर्वरी: शर्वरी शर्वरी, i. e. शॄ + वन् + ई, (with र् for न्, cf. शरु), f.  1. Night, Man. 1, 66.  2. A woman.  3. Tur-meric. -- Cf. probably as akin, Κέρϐερος.
शर्वरीक: शर्वरीक शर्वरी + क, adj. Hurtful, mischievous.
शल्: शल् शल्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To shake, to tremble (cf. चल्).  2. To cover. i. 1, Par. To go, to run. Cf. श्वल् and शठ्। -- With the prep. उद् उद्, i. 1, Par. To start up, Śiś. 3, 37. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उच्छलित।  1. Start-ing up, bubbling up, Pañc. i. d. 148.  2. Uncovered, Vikr. 57, 19. -- With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To spurt out, Śiś. 2, 66.
शल: शल शल, probably शॄ + अ (with ल् for र्),  I. m. and n. The quill of a porcupine.  II. m.  1. A dart.  2. A kind of field.  3. Brahman.
शलक: शलक शलक, m. A spider; Pañc. iii. d. 179, read शलाकां।
शलभ: शलभ शलभ (cf. शरभ), m.  1. A grasshopper, Pañc. i. d. 369; iv. d. 58 (cf. पतङ्ग).  2. A locust, Arj. 7, 24; Chr. 34, 13.
शलल: शलल शलल (cf. शल), n., and f. ली, The quill of a porcupine, Pāraskara, Gṛ. S. ii. 1, in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, vii. 532 (ली).
शलाका: शलाका शलाका (cf. शल), f.  1. A javelin.  2. An arrow.  3. A small stake, rod, the bar of a cage, Pañc. iii. d. 179; a rib of an umbrella, etc.  4. A fibrous stick used as a brush or pencil, Suśr. 1, 33, 18; a pencil, Ragh. 7, 8.  5. A porcupine.  6. A piece of ivory used in particular games, a do-mino, MBh. 5, 1225 (read °का-धूर्तान्, Sharpers).  7. A bone.  8. A bird, Tur-dus gosalica.  -- Comp. अयस्-कान्त-, f. a magnetised needle, Mālat. 14, 15. निःशलाक, i. e. निस्-। adj. (properly, free from the birds called Turdus gosa-lica), lonely, Man. 7, 147. वंश-, f. 1. the bambu pipe that forms the body of the lute. 2. any small bambu pin or stake, as the bar of a cage.
शल्क: शल्क शल्क, probably शॄ + क (with ल् for र्), n.  1. A part.  2. The bark of a tree.  3. The scale of a fish.  -- Comp. महा-, m. a prawn or shrimp, Man. 3, 272. स-, adj. scaly, Man. 5, 16.
शल्भ्: † शल्भ् शल्भ्, i. 1, Ātm. To boast.
शल्य: शल्य शल्य, i. e. शल + य,  I. m. and n.  1. A dart, a javelin.  2. An arrow, Utt. Rāmac. 46, 14; Chr. 30, 1 (m.).  II. m.  1. A peg, a pin.  2. A porcu-pine.  3. A thorny shrub, Vangueria spinosa.  4. A boundary.  5. The name of a king, Johns. Sel. 50, 98.  III. n.  1. Any stake or thorn, Bhartṛ. 2, 97.  2. An iron crow.  3. Any ex-traneous substance which has lodged in the body, as an arrow or thorn.  4. Difficulty.  5. Poison.  6. Sin.  7. Abuse.  -- Comp. निस्-, adj. free from an arrow, MBh. 6, 3375. °यम्, adv. free from pain or care, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 23. वि-, adj. 1. free from thorns or spikes, Rām. 6, 71, 24. 2. free from pain or care. स-, adj. 1. pierced by a thorn or dart. 2. pierced, Vikr. d. 29. 3. troublesome, difficult. -- Cf. κῆλα, pl.
शल्यक: शल्यक शल्य + क, m.  1. A thron, a stake.  2. A dart, a pike.  3. A hedge-hog, Man. 12, 65.  4. A porcupine, ib. 5, 18; Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 22.
शल्यवत्: शल्यवन्त् शल्य + वन्त्, adj.  1. Shoot-ing arrows, one who has shot an arrow, Man. 9, 44.  2. Set with stakes.  3. Harassed with difficulties.
शल्यवन्त्: शल्यवन्त् शल्य + वन्त्, adj.  1. Shoot-ing arrows, one who has shot an arrow, Man. 9, 44.  2. Set with stakes.  3. Harassed with difficulties.
शल्लक: शल्लक शल्लक (cf. शल्क and शल्य),  I. m. A plant, Bignonia indica.  II. f. की,  1. A porcupine.  2. The gum olibanum tree, Boswellia thurifera, Vikr. d. 107.  III. n. Bark, rind.
शल्व: शल्व शल्व, m. The name of a country.
शव्: शव् शव्, i. 1, Par.  1. To go.  2. To alter, to change, to destroy.
शव: शव शव,  I. m. and n. A dead body, Man. 4, 108; Pañc. v. d. 24 (m.); Kathās. 4, 107 (m.).  II. n. Water.
शवर: शवर शवर, m.  1. A barbarian tribe, a Śavara, Nalod. 3, 37.  2. f. री, A female of that tribe, Utt. Rāmac. 19, 14.  3. Śiva.  4. Water.  -- Comp. स्मर-, m. the शवर- like (i. e. cruel) god of love, Bhartṛ. 1, 94.
शवल: शवल शवल,  I. adj.  1. Variegated, of a variegated colour, Mālat. 145, 12; grown or yellow, Vikr. d. 109 (cf. Wil-son, Spec. of the Theatre of the Hind. 2. ed. i. 250, n.).  2. Imitative.  3. Ar-ticulated, Rājat. 5, 68 (divided, viz. by rivers).  II. f. ली।  1. A brindled cow.  2. The cow of plenty, Vaśiṣṭha's cow, Rām. 1, 52, 21.  III. n. Water.
शवलत्व: शवलत्व शवल + त्व, n. Alternation, Mālat. 161, 5.
शवस्: शवस् शवस्, i. e. शु (= श्वि), + अस्, n.  1. Power, strength, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.  2. A corpse.  -- Comp. सत्य-, adj. possessed of real strength, Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 86, 8.
